about.headline: Full stack developer at Kenmark ITanSolutions — 10+ production projects shipped
about.bio: I'm a full stack developer with 2.9 years at Kenmark ITanSolutions, delivering end-to-end systems for entertainment, maritime, ecommerce, and industrial IoT clients. I've built airport airfield lighting control dashboards (React, Socket.IO, Modbus TCP), Smaaash's full platform stack (marketing site, booking engine, Express API, admin dashboards), INMARCO conference websites, maritime calendar apps, and ecommerce storefronts with Prisma, payments, and admin CMS tooling. Comfortable across frontend, backend APIs, databases, auth, and deployment — with a focus on performance, SEO, and production reliability.
highlights: Full Stack Developer @ Kenmark ITanSolutions — 2 yrs 9 month, 10+ production projects
NASU: Real-time airport lighting HMI — React, Socket.IO, Modbus TCP, Canvas maps
Smaaash platform: Website, booking engine, Express API, multi-role admin dashboard
INMARCO, Maritime Calendar, Aerosailors & ecommerce clients — Next.js monorepos
B.E. Computer Engineering — University of Mumbai (2020–2023)

projects.title: Airport Lighting Control System Dashboard
projects.description: Real-time industrial HMI for airport runway and taxiway lighting — React, Socket.IO, and Modbus TCP with interactive airfield canvas, CCR control, fault monitoring, and 24/7 multi-server failover.
highlights: Canvas airfield map with zoom/pan, drag-and-drop device management, and live status indicators
WebSocket streaming with 60fps batching, connection health checks, and domain failover
CCR intensity control, utility toggles, global blackout orchestration, and SNMP network view
JWT roles (Admin/Operator/Viewer), system log export, and Python Tornado Modbus backend

projects.title: Smaaash Corporate / Media Website
projects.description: Full-stack corporate website on Next.js 15, React 19, MySQL, and Prisma — 95+ components, RBAC admin CMS, OTP party forms, LeadSquared CRM, and enterprise SEO.
highlights: 95+ components with Radix/shadcn, Tailwind v4, Zustand, TanStack Query
RBAC admin: SUPERADMIN, HR, CONTENT_MANAGER roles with JWT HTTP-only cookies
OTP-verified party enquiry flows, location-routed emails, GTM/Meta Pixel tracking
Dynamic sitemap, JSON-LD structured data, video optimization up to 90% size reduction

projects.title: Smaaash Bookings Engine
projects.description: Customer booking platform for gaming venues — Bowling, Cricket, Go-Karting slot selection, cart, Razorpay checkout, offers, and PWA support in a Next.js 16 monorepo.
highlights: Dynamic routing per game category with real-time slot availability from API
Cart, checkout, offers page with complex validation and JWT-secured sessions
Razorpay payment integration, GA4, Facebook Pixel, and catalog caching optimizations
Shared TypeScript packages across frontend and Express API via Turborepo

projects.title: Smaaash Admin & Operations Dashboard
projects.description: Multi-role React/Vite admin SPA for venue operations — Game Host, Center Head, and Admin portals with booking management, offers, vouchers, analytics, and CSRF-safe API integration.
highlights: Three role-based portals: Game Host, Center Head, Admin with separate auth flows
Bowling/cricket booking schedules, cancellations, order summaries, offer CRUD
PrimeReact DataTables with server-side pagination on high-volume booking lists
CSRF token handling, Vite proxy dev setup, and cross-origin cookie support

projects.title: INMARCO Conference Websites
projects.description: Turborepo monorepo delivering INMARCO maritime conference websites (2018, 2022, 2026 editions) — multi-page Next.js 16 apps with papers, galleries, committees, and brochure content.
highlights: Three conference site generations in a pnpm/Turborepo workspace with shared utilities
Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS across all editions
Content pages: papers, speakers, organizing committee, image galleries, venue info
Shared packages for logging, error handling, and UI consistency

projects.title: Maritime Calendar Web Application
projects.description: Full-stack calendar platform for maritime professionals — public Next.js site plus separate admin app for events, users, enrollment, newsletters, and reports across global timezones.
highlights: Monorepo: public web app + admin dashboard with shared Prisma, auth, UI, and email packages
Firebase Auth integration, MongoDB via Prisma, Jest test setup
Admin routes for dashboard, events, user management, enrollment, and reporting
Shared design system and TypeScript config across workspace packages

projects.title: Aerosailors Ecommerce Platform
projects.description: Next.js ecommerce storefront with Prisma/MongoDB CMS, product catalog, checkout, admin marketing tools, email notifications, and SEO optimization.

Prisma + MongoDB content management with admin API routes
Email notification system, SEO audit implementation, and WebP media handling
Tailwind CSS, Radix UI component patterns

projects.title: Smaaash Express API Backend

Razorpay payment verification, wallet/credits, order management, and cron jobs
JWT rotation, Helmet, CORS, express-rate-limit, Winston/Pino logging
OpenAPI/Swagger docs, Vitest tests, and offer audit digest emails

Admin modules for governance, compliance, CSR, and document management

Shared component library across monorepo workspaces

experience.description: Delivering full stack solutions across 10+ production client projects. Built NASU airport lighting HMI (React, Socket.IO, Modbus), the complete Smaaash platform (marketing site, booking engine, Express API, admin dashboard), INMARCO conference websites, Maritime Calendar app, and multiple ecommerce platforms (Aerosailors, Diamond Sensations, Nixa). Work spans Next.js/React frontends, Express/Node APIs, Prisma/Sequelize databases, JWT/RBAC auth, Razorpay payments, real-time systems, and Turborepo monorepos.
